package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/onboardingcontract"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type StudentOnboardingDraftGetter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingDraftPutter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizer interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error)
}

func (handler StudentOnboardingHandler) GetDraftProfile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.GetDraft == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding draft is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	draft, err := handler.GetDraft.Handle(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, draft)
}

func (handler StudentOnboardingHandler) PutDraftProfile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.PutDraft == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding draft is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request onboardingcontract.DraftReplaceRequest
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingcontract.DraftReplaceBodyLimit, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	draft, err := handler.PutDraft.Handle(r.Context(), request.UseCaseInput(studentID, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")))
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, draft)
}

func (handler StudentOnboardingHandler) FinalizeDraftProfile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.FinalizeDraft == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding draft is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request onboardingcontract.DraftFinalizeRequest
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingcontract.DraftFinalizeBodyLimit, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.FinalizeDraft.Handle(r.Context(), request.UseCaseInput(studentID, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")))
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}
